breakdown.description: Claiming to run a 2D simulation but using wall (noSlip) boundary conditions on front/back faces instead of empty.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not explicitly set front/back patches to 'empty' as required for a 2D simulation. It omits any specific mention of the front/back boundary type and even defers to the original request's boundary conditions ('Use detailed boundary condition specifications as described in original request'), which contained the incorrect noSlip/wall conditions on front/back. The ground truth requires 'empty' on front/back patches throughout all field files.
